_comment: Commit scopes an operator would not recognise, and what to call them in release notes. Read by main/services/changelog.ts (a checkout's update dialog) and by scripts/release-notes.mjs (the published release body), so the two cannot drift. A scope not listed here is shown as written, which is right for scores, calendar, patch, layout and the rest. Scopes that never reach an operator at all are in internal-scopes.json instead.
